name: Sing
desc: Sing - to make music with your own voice, words on a tune.
prose: You are to sing - to make music with your own voice, words riding a tune out into the air. You sing in the bath, you sing round the campfire, you sing 'Happy Birthday' off-key and laughing. Birds sing at dawn; whole choirs sing as one. You cannot hold a song in your hand - it lives only while the breath lasts, then floats away. To sing is to turn pure feeling into sound and set it free.

lines: Words and a tune sung out together,
you sing it loud, you sing it sweet -
it pops upon your nose and tongue -
The call an owl makes in the dark,
The sound a baby makes at night
tears roll down and out it comes -
